completed_tasks.name: Fix -itsoffset shifting audio stream — 9s cabin lag
completed_tasks.note: -itsoffset shifts [1:a] as well as [1:v]. With itsoffset=8.529, atrim start=2.441 becomes a no-op (all audio already past trim point). asetpts resets from 8.529→0, causing cabin audio at raw PTS=0 instead of 2.441s in. Fix: remove -itsoffset, use setpts=PTS+cabin_shift/TB on [1:v] only inside pip_chain.

decisions.rationale: -itsoffset operates at demuxer level and shifts all streams including audio. The audio atrim chain depends on [1:a] starting at raw PTS=0 from the concat demuxer. Using setpts on [1:v] only inside the filter graph is the correct approach.
Empirically derived. After the setpts fix, 2s residual cabin lag remained. Constant stepped from 0.5 to 2.5 to compensate.

decisions.decision: cabin_pts_offset probed at render time from actual first-packet PTS in segments
decisions.rationale: Brio at 15fps produces slightly more segments than ELP at 30fps over time (~-1.93s after 6-8 mins, ~0.021s at startup). Probing at render time corrects this drift automatically.
